hooks.command: sh -c 'set -e; input=$(cat); name=$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r .name); cwd=$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r .cwd); dir="$cwd/.claude/worktrees/$name"; if [ ! -e "$dir/.git" ]; then git -C "$cwd" worktree add "$dir" -b "agent/$name" 1>&2; fi; (cd "$dir" && deno task dev worktree 1>&2); printf %s "$dir"'
sh -c 'input=$(cat); dir=$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r .worktree_path); (cd "$dir" && deno task dev worktree:teardown 1>&2) || true'
